content_sections.heading: About DDP Planning Officer (Land Systems)
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Planning & Coordination is part of the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Its office is at 5th Floor, C-Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi – 110001 (Tele: 23072314). The Planning Officer (Land Systems) post handles defence capital acquisition work related to the Land Systems of the Indian armed forces.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be prepared in the attached Bio-Data Proforma only, duly recommended by the concerned administrative authorities, and forwarded so as to reach this address within 45 days of the date of issue of the circular: Jt Dir (Adm & Coord), Directorate of Planning & Coordination, Ministry of Defence, Room No. 501, 5th Floor, 'C' Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi-110001 The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or what to write on the envelope. Applications are to be forwarded only for eligible and willing officers who can be spared for the full tenure in the event of their selection. The Bio-Data Proforma (pages 5 and 6 of the circular) asks for: Name and address in block letters, date of birth (in Christian era) and date of retirement under Central/State Govt rules. Educational qualifications possessed and details of desirable qualifications possessed (as in Para 3 of the circular). A brief description of experience relevant to the post (maximum 100 words). Details of employment in chronological order: office/organisation/station, post held, from, to, pay level and basic pay, and nature of duties (a separate signed sheet may be enclosed). A clear statement whether the applicant meets the requirements of the post, nature of present employment, and, if on deputation or contract, the date of initial appointment, period of appointment and parent office. Whether working under Central Government, State Government, an autonomous organisation, a Government Undertaking or a University, with details of the Cadre Controlling Authority; revised pay scale details; total emoluments per month now drawn; additional information; whether SC/ST; and remarks. Date, signature, present place of posting, office address, communication address, e-mail, mobile and landline number.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The circular has one post: Planning Officer (Land Systems), 01 (One) vacancy, in Pay Level-13 as per the 7th CPC. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; eligibility is set by the service the officer belongs to. Mode / Eligibility (transfer on deputation of serving government officers / short term contract of employees of PSUs): (i) Suitable officers of All India Services or officers holding analogous posts in Central Civil Services Group 'A' or in DRDO; OR (ii) Appointment on short term contract of officers holding analogous posts from Public Sector Undertakings; OR (iii) Serving Service Officers holding the substantive rank of Col/ Capt/ Gp Capt in Indian Army/Navy/Air Force respectively. Residual service: The officer applying for the deputation post must have a residual service of 06 years with effect from the date of issue of the vacancy circular. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Desirable qualifications (Para 3 of the circular): Overall performance of the officer must be well above average; the officer should not have been permanently superseded for promotion. Proficient in DAP 2020 and defence capital acquisition procedures. Held appointments related to Land System Equipment (Armoured Fighting Vehicles (AFVs), Armament Systems, Ammunition & Explosives, Combat Vehicles, specialist vehicles etc.). Qualified on DSSC/TSOC. Pay and terms of deputation: The pay of the officer selected on deputation will be regulated as per existing government orders/instructions. Service Officers on deputation shall continue to draw their pay and allowance from their respective CDAs in the case of selection. The period of deputation, as per the existing Recruiting Rules of the Dte of P&C for the post of Planning Officer, shall not ordinarily exceed 05 years, which may be extended in public interest as per rules on the subject. For computing the total period of deputation, the period of deputation in any other ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment would also be taken into account. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: DDP Planning Officer (Land Systems) Job Description
content_sections.text: The circular lists these QRs/job specifications for the post: Process defence capital acquisition cases as per DAP 2020 with respect to weapon systems/equipment of Land systems of Indian armed forces (cases to be fielded in SPB/DPB/DAC/GSEPC). In-depth understanding of procedural frameworks governing RFI, SQR, AoN and related capital procurement stages as outlined in the Defence Acquisition Procedure. Coordinate with Indian industry (private and public sector) to access the capability existing in Indian industry in respect of equipment related to Land Systems (AFVs, Armament Systems, Ammunition & Explosives, combat vehicles, specialist vehicles etc.). Conduct technology scans in the domain of defence Land Systems to develop a comprehensive and continuously updated database of products, emerging technologies, production capacities across the country, import dependency on foreign companies for various technologies etc. Represent the Department of Defence Production (DDP) in Project Facilitation Teams (PFTs) for Make projects, in accordance with DAP provisions. Close interaction with R&D organisations, DPSUs and industry federations such as SIDM, FICCI, CII etc. Monitoring of projects which become the responsibility of the division.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the attached Bio-Data Proforma, duly recommended by the concerned administrative authorities. ACR Dossier or authenticated copies of the last 5 years' ACRs/APARs. A certificate from the administrative authority that the particulars furnished by the officer are correct and that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the officer. Integrity Certificate & Declaration Regarding Penalty (page 7), signed by the Competent Authority, certifying that the officer's integrity is beyond doubt and stating either that no penalty has been imposed in the last ten years or the nature of penalty, delinquency and period. For PSU applicants: supporting documents regarding holding an analogous post in the parent cadre. For service officers: record of service, which can be submitted wherever considered desirable.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for Planning Officer (Land Systems) in DDP?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) post of Planning Officer (Land Systems) in the Directorate of Planning & Coordination, Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Jt Dir (Adm & Coord) within 45 days of the date of issue of the circular dated 20 November 2026, which is about 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the DDP Planning Officer (Land Systems) post?
faq.answer: Officers of All India Services or holding analogous posts in CCS Group 'A' or DRDO (deputation), officers holding analogous posts in PSUs (short term contract), or serving Col/Capt/Gp Capt of the Indian Army/Navy/Air Force respectively can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the Planning Officer (Land Systems) post?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level-13 as per the 7th CPC; the pay of an officer on deputation is regulated as per existing government orders, and Service Officers continue to draw pay and allowance from their CDAs.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the attached Bio-Data Proforma, recommended by your administrative authorities, with the ACR Dossier or last 5 years' ACRs/APARs, to Jt Dir (Adm & Coord), Directorate of Planning & Coordination, Ministry of Defence, Room No. 501, 5th Floor, 'C' Block, Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q6. What is the period of deputation?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 05 years and may be extended in public interest as per rules; immediately preceding deputation in any other ex-cadre post also counts.

faq.question: Q7. How much residual service is needed?
faq.answer: The officer must have a residual service of 06 years with effect from the date of issue of the vacancy circular, that is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can I withdraw my application later?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications?
faq.answer: Well-above-average performance without permanent supersession, proficiency in DAP 2020 and defence capital acquisition procedures, appointments related to Land System Equipment, and qualification on DSSC/TSOC.
